_comment: POST /advisor/recommendations/{id}/override (SDD §12, §14.6): what the API's request model OverrideRequest (option: Strategy, reason: str | None at most 2000 characters, extra fields forbidden) refuses from the body alone - before the route looks the recommendation up, so for one it does not know too -, then the 404 a valid body gets for an unknown id. A 422's message is validation_message over pydantic's errors: the model's fields in their order, then the extra inputs, five at most. "[2001]" stands for a reason of 2001 characters. Shared by seamless/tests/test_api_advisor.py and dashboard/src/api/mock.test.ts (reviews RV42B-01, RV43B-07).
